source_credit: D.C. Parker, H.A.G. Houghton and Michael Phelps; EMEL capture, July 2018
source_format: 51 individual spectral-capture JPEG derivatives; 1533 x 2044, grayscale 8-bit; not sensor RAW or master TIFFs

processing.selection: All MB and W filename families; Aux, RL, RR, TX excluded before fitting
processing.limitation: Feature-level holdout errors are not letter-level validation; SIFT orientation duplicates are not independent physical controls.

inspection.decision: No new reading or improvement over the published composite established by this pilot. This is not proof that the images contain no recoverable information.
inspection.observations: Components vary the contrast of later writing, folds and texture. Residual shapes have not been assigned securely to the sought undertext.
